settings.fontScaleHint: Schimbă mărimea întregii interfațe, nu doar a mesajelor.
settings.highContrastHint: Face marginile și textul mai lizibile fată de fundal.

settings.showHomeHint: Păstrează un buton de Casă în partea de sus a barei din stânga, care listează toate camerele și adaugă un buton de Diez care conține toate camerele fâră spațiu.

settings.uniformIconsHint: Dă un fundal bazat pe culoarea iconiței iconițelor de cameră sau spațiu care au un fundal transparent.

settings.hour24ClockHint: Dezactivarea va folosii ceasul pe care îl folosește sistemul tău.

settings.sessionReplayHint: Adaugă o înregistrare cu ce ai apăsat înainte de eroare. Textul, fișele și click-urile sunt mascate înainte de a fi trimise.

settings.telemetryReloadNotice: Reîncarcă pagina ca trimiterea de rapoarte să își ia efect.

settings.showRoomIconHint: Show each room”s avatar beside its name.

settings.emoteRoomsHint: Packs you have chosen to use outside the room that publishes them.

settings.desktopDescription: The window frame and the system tray icon.

settings.showSystemTrayIconHint: Some desktops have nowhere to put it; the switch does nothing there.
